agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: “Paul says in this tent we groan.”, “Me?”, and “I groan just leaning down to peek in the oven, and NOBODY approved that noise.” Non-opening story cards are limited to two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: This is a where question, but “Before the throne of Caesar” is not a real detail from somewhere in the Bible. The Bible refers to Caesar’s judgment seat (Acts 25:10), not to a throne of Caesar.

rule.text: For who, which thing and where questions, wrong answers are real details from somewhere in the Bible, like Joppa when the right answer is Tarshish.
